en.body: Cambridge Hospital Abu Dhabi welcomed Abu Dhabi Municipality representatives as part of the “Your Joy Is Our Eid” initiative. Gifts were distributed to inpatients, creating a celebratory experience while strengthening the relationship between the hospital and the Municipality around patient engagement and community support.
